messages:
Noah: FYI customer support flagged a partner-metered account where usage showed up under a legacy SKU (redwood-lite) instead of partner_sku_99. Looks like ingestion mapping changed during last connector release.
Yara: Oof. Do we have a sense of exposure (underbilling vs duplicate)?
Sam: Running a quick diff between ledger lines and partner events for partner_id=99 now.
BillingBot: Alert: mismatched SKU mapping detected for partner 99 between 2026-05-05T08:00:00Z and 2026-05-05T12:00:00Z. Potential undercharge window.
PartnerEng: We pushed connector v2.14 which unintentionally dropped sku_mapping for batched payloads if sku_field was nested. Partner switched to nested sku last week.
Noah: Can you share the query to surface affected customers? Legal wants an initial estimate.
Sam: Query I ran:
```sql
SELECT p.event_id, p.customer_id, p.payload_sku, l.ledger_sku, p.event_ts
FROM partner_events p
LEFT JOIN ledger_lines l ON p.event_id = l.source_event_id
WHERE p.partner_id = 99
  AND p.event_ts BETWEEN '2026-05-05T08:00:00Z' AND '2026-05-05T12:00:00Z'
  AND p.payload_sku != l.ledger_sku;
```
Yara: Results: 37 events where payload_sku = 'partner_sku_99' but ledger_sku = 'redwood-lite'. Total delta value ~$2,300 if billed at partner rate. 5 of those customers are on reserved plans and must remain untouched.
Noah: Short term mitigation?
PartnerEng: Hotfix: re-apply sku_mapping during ingestion and compute a sku_fingerprint fallback. Pushing PR now.
InfraOps: We can run a targeted ledger reclassification job that reassigns ledger_sku where source_event_id matches and mark as rebill_pending=true. Needs a downtime window for ledger reindex (5m).
Sam: I can prepare the reclassification SQL dry-run:
```sql
UPDATE ledger_lines
SET ledger_sku = p.payload_sku, rebill_pending = true
FROM partner_events p
WHERE ledger_lines.source_event_id = p.event_id
  AND ledger_lines.ledger_sku != p.payload_sku
  AND p.partner_id = 99
  AND p.event_ts BETWEEN '2026-05-05T08:00:00Z' AND '2026-05-05T12:00:00Z';
```
Yara: Before running, we need to exclude reserved customers and capture pre-change snapshot for audit. Also generate credits/invoices for any differences.
BillingBot: Suggested steps:
1) Snapshot affected ledger_lines (export CSV)
2) Run dry-run of reclassification and compute invoice deltas
3) Exclude reserved_contracts from changes
4) Apply fix and queue rebill job
BillingBot: Note: tag partner record with incident_note and notify finance.
Noah: Partner notification? We should give them a postmortem and ask for a replay if they want full parity.
PartnerEng: Notified partner with the summary and requested their replay of batched payloads. PR: https://github.com/redwood/marketplace-connectors/pull/534 fixes nested sku parsing.
InfraOps: I can run the 5m ledger reindex at 2026-05-05T19:00:00Z UTC after snapshots are uploaded.
Sam: Dry-run results: 32 of 37 events reclassify to partner_sku_99; 5 legitimate mapping mismatches remain (manual review). Estimated rebill: $2,145.
Yara: I'll coordinate with Finance to decide whether to issue invoices or apply credits.
Noah: Action owners: PartnerEng (merge hotfix + confirm replay), Sam (run reclassification and attach snapshot), InfraOps (schedule reindex), Yara (finance liaison). Update this thread when each step complete. :thumbsup:
PartnerEng: Hotfix merged and deployed to staging. Partner confirmed they will hold replay until we greenlight.
BillingBot: Closed loop: reclassification completed in dry-run. Waiting for production window.
Noah: Thanks everyone — keeping this as the source of truth. We'll retitle for the postmortem after closure.
